    n = len(nums)
    expected_sum = n * (n + 1) // 2

def rotate_left(arr: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:

    k %= n

    arr[k:] = reversed(arr[k:])
    arr.reverse()

    while left < right:
